auto_fail_flags.label: Unbounded free pilot
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller agreed to a free pilot without accuracy, latency, or exit gates.

auto_fail_flags.label: No evaluation harness
auto_fail_flags.description: Accuracy and latency exit gates never came up in the conversation.

auto_fail_flags.label: Commit without a forecast
auto_fail_flags.description: The seller proposed a commit before asking the buyer for any volume or usage numbers.

transition_banner.body: Consumption grows only when the eval harness proves value.

drills.title: Re-clear risk and security for production
drills.prompt: The pilot passed. Map the approval path for each new use case, and start the production security review now.

drills.prompt: Find who funds the expansion, and what the cloud provider's native option would really cost them.

drills.prompt: Set the production number the ramp must hit, and price the cost of usage that stalls after launch.

boss_fight.title: Boss fight · Eval harness
